text: The 18 emotion values in bench_consciousness_universe.py:153+ are arithmetic over sha256(name) bits and never read the simulation output at all — the heatmap the owner originally pasted is a rendering of a hash. Flagged in QD-1 as out of scope. Fixing it needs a decision about what emotions should be grounded in, since there is no emotion ground truth in the repo.

gate g in bench_consciousness_universe has no mechanism selecting it toward 1/2 — only the deleted pull term ever moved it (mean |g-0.5| 0.055 -> 0.280 once removed). QD-1 left it honest rather than pulled; whether g should converge at all is an open design question.
